Tachyon
 
Card Management for Digital Age
 
Seamlessly manage the complete lifecycle of any payment instrument - digital/virtual cards, physical cards, tokens, QR codes, wearables and more.
 
Contact Sales 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Tachyon Card Management Capabilities
 
 
 
 
Self-Service Configuration
 
Control every aspect of your payment products from provisioning (setting up BINs, splitting BINs, mapping products), issuance (physical or virtual) to fulfillment (print vendors and inventory controls) easily through intuitive web-based interfaces.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Card Lifecycle Management
 
 
 
Manage the entire card lifecycle from issuance to closure
 
 
 
 
 
 
Instant issuance of cards to allow cardholders to transact immediately
 
 
 
 
 
 
Generation of embossing files and seamless support for physical card issuance
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Usage of multiple channels to enable card activation
 
 
 
 
 
 
Common card management functions like blocking, renewal, expiry, and replacement
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Tokenization management including token issuance and suspend/resume/delete functions for device and Card on File (CoF) tokens
 
 
 
 
 
 
Push and pull token provisioning with ability to renew/replace cards without updating underlying tokens
